Job Title: Vue.js Developer
Experience: 0+ years
Location: Hybrid: Hyderabad, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Vue.js
- Nuxt.js
Good to have:
- JavaScript
- HTML

Responsibilities:
- Join a small, fast-moving product team at a growing Hyderabad-based software company focused on B2B SaaS for retail analytics.
- Implement responsive UI components and pages using Vue.js and Nuxt.js consistent with design specifications and product requirements.
- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to integrate frontend features with APIs and ensure smooth data flows.
- Write clean, maintainable code and unit tests; participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend best practices.
- Assist in optimizing page load performance, SEO-friendly server-side rendering in Nuxt, and accessibility improvements.
- Help troubleshoot and debug issues across browsers and devices; participate in sprint planning and regular Agile ceremonies.
- Contribute to documentation for component libraries, onboarding guides, and deployment processes.
